risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.88), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions for XLI industrials exposure.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI14, Stoch, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone contrarian signal and proximity to support (86.811) create a classic bounce setup for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally below all moving averages (9/21/50/200 EMA/SMA) with negative MACD, distribution pressure (CMF), and a macro environment in crisis (VIX 432.88, rising USD, imminent CPI) that invalidates technical oversold signals.
